      "snippet": "Next is to wire your “can’t load everything” reality into MetaBlooms as an actual loader, not just a spec.
I shipped a minimal, modular Corpus Mount Loader v1 that:

reads your corpus registry

infers (or accepts) the request domain

selects a small working set under a budget

verifies sha256 where provided

fails closed (refuses to mount anything that’s missing or mismatched)

emits a mount report JSON you can append to EvidenceChain

Download
